verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair capability to ask of an email API platform, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a sandbox, test mode, or separate non-production environment. Pods provide isolation between customers' data, and scoped API keys restrict access, but these are multi-tenancy and permission controls, not a sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
